name: employeflow
description: Your Employeflow AI team, worked by your own Claude: picks up the tasks you give your employees in your portal, does each one in that employee's role, and puts the result in your portal's Results.

team_key.title: Connect code
team_key.description: The connect code from the Connect tab in your Employeflow portal: only the part that starts with efb_. After saving, start a new session.
